items.desc: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
items.zh: 面向代码编辑与多人协作的桌面编辑器，提供 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 版本。

intro.audience: 开发者与代码编辑器工具作者。
use_cases: 编辑代码并开展多人协作
研究或贡献跨平台编辑器实现
intro.what: 这是支持协作的代码编辑器项目，提供三种桌面系统的安装及源码构建入口，并开放贡献；README 将 Web 版本列为尚未提供的平台。

items.desc: An open-source engine that turns continuous content streams into search and monitoring. Durable ingestion, hybrid search, alerts, and plugins for formats, models and business rules.
A modern JavaScript utility library that's 2-3 times faster and up to 97% smaller, a major upgrade to lodash.
mimalloc is a compact general purpose allocator with excellent performance.
An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
items.zh: Rust 编写的 Python 包与项目管理工具，整合依赖、环境、工具和版本管理。

intro.audience: Python 开发者与项目维护团队。
use_cases: 管理项目依赖与锁文件
运行带依赖的脚本或 Python 工具
intro.what: 这是 Python 包与项目管理器，支持依赖锁定、工作区、脚本运行、Python 版本管理和包工具安装，并提供兼容 pip 的接口。

items.desc: This is a Phi Family of SLMs book for getting started with Phi Models. Phi a family of open sourced AI models developed by Microsoft. Phi models are the most capable and cost-effective small language models (SLMs) available, outperforming models of the same size and next size up across a variety of language, reasoning, coding, and math benchmarks

Opensource IDE For Exploring and Testing API's (lightweight alternative to Postman/Insomnia)
items.zh: 以本地文件保存请求集合的 API 客户端，可用 Git 管理和协作测试资料。

intro.audience: 后端、测试与 API 开发者。
use_cases: 创建和执行 API 请求进行调试
用 Git 记录及共享请求集合
intro.what: 这是 API 探索与测试客户端，用纯文本 Bru 格式将请求集合保存在本地目录，可通过 Git 协作，并提供桌面应用与 CLI；另有商业功能版本。

items.desc: VILA is a family of state-of-the-art vision language models (VLMs) for diverse multimodal AI tasks across the edge, data center, and cloud.

items.zh: 整理技术面试准备资料，涵盖算法、简历与行为面内容。

use_cases: 整理技术简历与求职材料
复习行为面试常见问题

items.desc: Open-source AI orchestration framework for building context-engineered, production-ready LLM applications. Design modular pipelines and agent workflows with explicit control over retrieval, routing, memory, and generation. Built for scalable agents, RAG, multimodal applications, semantic search, and conversational systems.
